# fyre_vm (Resource)

Manages a Fyre VM resource with full lifecycle support. Note: The VM identifier can be vm_id, IP address, or FQDN for update and delete operations.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `os` (String) Operating system (required). Use the fyre_vm_os_available data source to see available options.

### Optional

- `additional_disks` (List of String) Additional disk sizes in GB (max 2). Can be added after creation but not removed.
- `cpu` (Number) Number of CPUs. Defaults to 4. Can be updated after creation.
- `description` (String) VM description. Can be updated after creation.
- `disable_delete` (String) Disable deletion of the VM to prevent accidental deletes (y or n). Can be updated after creation.
- `dns` (String) Add hostname to DNS in dev.fyre.ibm.com domain (y or n). Defaults to n.
- `expiration` (String) Expiration time in hours or 'X days X hours' format (max 90 days). Can be updated after creation.
- `hostname` (String) Hostname for the VM. If not provided, will be auto-generated by the API. Can be updated after creation.
- `memory` (Number) Memory in GB. Defaults to 8. Can be updated after creation.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Custom password for the VM. Can be updated after creation.
- `platform` (String) Platform type (x, pvm, or z). Defaults to x.
- `product_group_id` (String) Product group identifier. Required when quota_type is 'product_group'. Defaults to user's default product group.
- `public_network` (String) Assign public IP address (y or n). Defaults to n.
- `quota_type` (String) Type of quota to use (product_group or quick_burn). Defaults to product_group.
- `site` (String) Site location (svl or rtp). Defaults to 'svl' or inherits from provider configuration.
- `ssh_keys` (List of String) SSH public keys to add to the VM. Can be a list of keys.
- `time_to_live` (String) Time to live in hours. Required when quota_type is 'quick_burn'.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Creation timestamp
- `expiration_time` (String) Absolute expiration timestamp returned by the API (computed, read-only)
- `fqdn` (String) Fully Qualified Domain Name of the VM
- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the VM (same as vm_id)
- `ips` (Attributes List) List of IP addresses assigned to the VM. These are assigned by the Fyre API and cannot be set by the user. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ips))
- `location` (String) VM location
- `state` (String) Current state of the VM
- `vm_id` (String) The VM identifier (format: x-xxxxxxx)

<a id="nestedatt--ips"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ips`

Read-Only:

- `ip` (String) IP address
- `scope` (String) IP scope
- `type` (String) IP type (private or public)
